final_message:
Fixed. The bug was in `_eligible` in `billing/discounts.py`. The plan-restriction check read `price_id is None and plan_of.get(price_id) in plans`, so a line with a real price never matched a plan-restricted coupon. I changed it to `price_id is not None`.

The full suite now passes (25 tests), including your reproduction. I added that test as `tests/test_discounts_plan.py` and wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}`.

steps.command: sed -n 55,140p billing/discounts.py; grep -n "discounts\.\|plan_id\|\"plan\"" billing/engine.py | head -40; grep -n "team" tests/conftest.py

sed -i 's/return price_id is None and plan_of.get(price_id) in plans/return price_id is not None and plan_of.get(price_id) in plans/' billing/discounts.py && echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

cat >> tests/test_discounts_plan.py <<'EOF'
from billing import discounts


def test_plan_restricted_coupon(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "team", percent_off=5000, applies_to_plans=[world.team["id"]])
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1), (world.team_monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert [line["discount_amount"] for line in inv["lines"]] == [0, 1500]
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
